test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence.

She could sense something __ominous__ in the darkness of the night.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **inauspicious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ominous"** means giving the impression that something bad or unpleasant is going to happen; threatening; inauspicious. (अशुभ)

 
 
• **Example: **The dark clouds in the sky looked ominous, indicating that a storm was approaching.
 
 
 
• **"Inauspicious"** refers to something that is not conducive to success; unpromising. (अशुभ)
 
 
• **Example: **The inauspicious start to the day made her worry about the outcome of her important meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'ominous'** is **'inauspicious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **inauspicious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Propitious** (अनुकूल): Giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable.

 
 
• **Example: **It was a propitious moment to ask for a raise.
 
 
 
• **Profane** (अपवित्र): Relating or devoted to that which is not sacred or biblical; secular rather than religious.
 
 
• **Example: **His profane language shocked the congregation.
 
 
 
• **Blissful** (आनंदमय): Extremely happy; full of joy.
 
 
• **Example: **They enjoyed a blissful vacation in the mountains.
